annotations.annotation_text: Structural opening of Book 1, Chapter 8, page 198. Continues the multi-layered dream narrative depicting the nocturnal transmigration of human history and Dublin topography.
sources: Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. https://jhupbooks.press.jhu.edu/title/annotations-finnegans-wake

annotations.annotation_text: Universal archetype of the father and everyman protagonist Humphrey Chimpden Earwicker (HCE), manifested here as "H.C.E". Represents the recumbent Dublin landscape with head at Howth and body stretching west to Phoenix Park.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
McHugh, Roland. The Sigla of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/siglaoffinnegans0000mchu

annotations.annotation_text: Mid-page polysemic discourse on page 198: Joyce weaves multilingual puns, etymological roots, and rhythmic cadences capturing the shifting consciousness of the collective unconscious.
sources: Tindall, William York. A Reader's Guide to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/readersguidetofi00tind
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
